title: Kernel Contracts corpus entry
description: One measured (or, if marked illustrative, synthesized) cross-silicon divergence case, annotated against a contract class and a three-state calibration result. Field names track the contract-triple semantics in the Kernel Contracts paper, section 3.

entry_id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. KC-0001. Never reused, even if an entry is superseded.

status.description: 'measured' = produced by running harness/run.py against real silicon. 'illustrative' = worked example, not a measurement. Illustrative entries must not be counted toward corpus size claims.

name.description: e.g. matmul, softmax, attention, reduction_sum, gather

primitive.description: Which of the three physical primitives (paper section 3.7) this class instantiates.

eta.description: The tolerance bound. For composite structures, the binding component.

derivation.description: How eta was derived. Must name a first-principles source (unit roundoff, condition number correction, invariant definition) -- never 'measured from candidate under test'. See paper section 3.11 on why the latter is disallowed.

divergence.description: Measured value of the tolerance function tau(x, y*, y) for the worst-case or aggregate sample.

method.description: e.g. 'max over 1024 samples from calibration distribution mu'

calibration.description: Three-state calibration record (paper section 5.1). A contract without both states recorded is not falsifiable.

result.description: A well-calibrated contract should FAIL the injected-bad candidate. A 'pass' here means the contract is under-specified.

injection_method.description: e.g. 'forced downcast to fp16 accumulator', 'shuffled reduction order', 'clamp-instead-of-raise on OOB index'

verdict.description: 'under_specified' = divergence observed but not attributable to any clause in this entry's contract_class (paper section 3.4, case 3).
